title: DairyChain
tagline: Dairy supply chain simulation. AI Agents to handle supply chain operations and talk to smart contract.
description:
DairyChain is a simulation-based project that models an end-to-end dairy supply chain, where multiple autonomous agents represent different roles along the chain. The simulation covers the journey of dairy products—from collection at the farm to inspection, processing, management, dispatch, distribution, and ultimately retail. In the current MVP stage, the project integrates blockchain technology to implement tokenization as a reward mechanism. Each agent (robot) is assigned a wallet address, and when specific tasks are successfully completed, on-chain payments (incentives) are automatically transferred to the agent’s wallet. This ensures transparency and incentivizes efficient operations.

Core Idea:
The project aims to demonstrate that autonomous agents operating in a complex supply chain can be incentivized and held accountable through an immutable blockchain-based reward mechanism. For the MVP, the focus is on:
Recording supply chain events on-chain.
Distributing tokenized rewards based on performance.
Implementing role and access management to ensure integrity.
how_its_made:
This project uses Babylon.js library to create simulation of dairy supply chain system. I'm using next.js for frontend. 

Solidity Smart contract is created and deployed using Remix IDE. 

For AI Agent, I was planning to use coinbase AgentKit, but unfortunately coinbase developer platfrom is not available in my country India. So I decided to use Langchain to create agents. Viem for contract interactions.
